Author: Rayla Petal
Name: PoseKit
Description: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Punchline: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Changelog: Add override queue: once both partners check "Override queue" (mutual consent required), whoever already has a pick queued can force-select the other's animation with a second click instead of waiting for them to pick — the forcing side plays its own pick immediately, and the partner's client resolves the forced name against its own presets/animations and plays it if found.
